summary: Script is well-written (excellent Set-StrictMode, error handling, param validation, docs) but deliverable is incomplete. Missing: (1) Pester test file (.Tests.ps1) with TDD red-green-refactor cycles, (2) fixture JSON files (fixtures/*.json referenced by workflow but never defined), (3) act-based test harness to run tests via `act push` and capture output to act-result.txt, (4) actionlint validation step in workflow, (5) test fixture setup/teardown. Task explicitly required TDD, Pester tests runnable via `Invoke-Pester`, and an act harness capturing verified results—none present. Workflow runs cleanup on mock data but doesn't invoke/verify any tests. ~60% complete.
